description: Use this when someone needs a local, owner-operated home-service business (plumber, HVAC, electrician, roofer, lawn care, tree service or fence) in Oklahoma, Kansas, Nebraska, Iowa or Missouri. Returns up to 5 businesses with name, phone, trade, service area, services and hours so the user can call or request a quote. Coverage is limited to the listed metros and nearby towns.

city.description: City and state, e.g. 'Tulsa, OK' or 'Omaha'.

problem.description: Optional: what's wrong, e.g. 'water heater leaking'. Used to rank by services.

trade.description: Kind of work needed. Default any.

name: find_local_pros
